koma.help_effect: Increase the maximum amount of special bars by 1.
koma.quote: Increase the maximum amount of special bars by 1.

koma.support_effect: Edajima appears and stands there saying something in Japanese followed by an aura burst in the shape of himself (same animation as his A-special); steals 2 SP bars. Guide notes it requires an Action Reply code to unlock, and another for wifi.
koma.quote: Edajima appears and stands there saying something in japanese followed by an aura burst in the shape of himself. It's the same animation as his A-special. 30 neutral damage, 45 super effective damage. Steals 2 SP bars.

passives: Principal - Gains more SP when KOing, hard to knock back.

specials.name: I AM THE PRINCIPAL OF OTOKOJUKU, EDAJIMA HEIHACH-
specials.description: Edajima says something in a text bubble followed by a red aura burst in the shape of himself. Strange hit box that hits above and a little to the side; small lag before the aura burst appears.
specials.quote: It has a strange hit box-- it hits above and a little to the side. Also, there's a small lag before the aura burst appears. 52 neutral damage, 78 super effective damage. Steals 2 SP bars and paralyzes.

specials.name: Shintoumetsukyakusu Rebahimomatasuzushi
specials.description: Edajima jumps up, grabs a satellite, and smashes it into the ground. Hit box lands in the center of the next screen over, which can cause accidental self-ring-out if used near the edge.
specials.quote: Edajima jumps up, grabs a satellite and smashes it into the ground. ... It hits in the center of the next screen over ... 60 neutral damage, 90 super effective.

moves.description: A simple punch, standard basic punch and combo starter with fairly high priority.
moves.quote: A simple punch. Damage 7/10/15. Punch type.

moves.name: FB
moves.description: A double punch mini combo that combos easily from B; can be cut off between the two punches to mix up attack pattern.
moves.quote: A double punch mini combo. Damage 15/21/31. Punch Type.

moves.name: UB
moves.description: An upward thrust with a pitchfork; will not hit most smaller-sized characters. Combos from B and knocks the opponent into the air.
moves.quote: An upward thrust with a pitch fork. Damage 7/10/15. Sword Type.

moves.name: DB
moves.description: A self lightning strike, called Edajima's worst move; only hits if his sprite is actually touching the opponent.
moves.quote: A self lightning strike. Damage 8/11/16. Punch type.

moves.name: AB
moves.description: An airborne doggie paddle; standard aerial attack.
moves.quote: An airborne doggie paddle. Damage 9/12/18. Punch type.

moves.description: A one-legged kick combo, the standard multi-hitting attack; can be comboed from any B attack. Has crazy fast priority.
moves.quote: A one legged kick combo. Damage 6-15/9-21/13-31. Punch type.

moves.name: FY
moves.description: A flying aura-punch, called Edajima's 2nd worst attack; slow moving aura fist with heavy startup lag and bad range. Can be held to charge and released automatically; good for edge guarding.
moves.quote: A flying aura-punch. Damage 11-18/15-25/22-37. Punch type.

moves.name: UY
moves.description: An uppercut that summons a tornado; comboes from any B attack (except AB) and sometimes Y against a wall; great for guard pressure and edge guarding.
moves.quote: An uppercut that summons a tornado. Damage 19/26/39. Punch type.

moves.name: DY
moves.description: Rock throw; Edajima rips out a slab of concrete and throws it. Oddly deals neutral damage even against opponents with the take-less-from-punches koma; won't hit some smaller characters while guarding.

moves.name: AY
moves.description: An aerial head butt; Edajima slams his head into the ground at a 45 degree angle. Cannot be stopped once started; goes through many attacks.
moves.quote: An aerial head butt. Damage 15/20/30. Punch type.

combos: B, UB, UY, Gokudera3, X, move forward a little, B, FB, UY, Yugi2, UX = 282 Damage.
unresolved: Guide labels damage as R/N/S (reduced/neutral/super effective) rather than knowledge/laughter/power terminology used elsewhere; kept as written.
DY is called 'Unknown type' by the guide despite other moves being typed Punch/Sword.
Guide references a 'hacked beta koma' for Edajima ('Three if you count the hacked beta koma') but never describes it further.
